text:
mira: Quick note — ran a targeted handshake experiment on draft model dorado-lite-13b-quant this morning. Short: ~20% p50 token latency drop, small numeric/code EM regressions. Artifacts: gs://redwood-experiments/handshake/6161617000.tar.gz.

sam: Awesome. Which handshake config?

mira: handshake-window=3, cheap-sampler temp=0.7 topk=50, fallback to beam when mismatch. Command: `./run_eval --model dorado-lite-13b-quant --decode speculative-handshake --handshake-window 3 --seed 42`.

leo: Any signal on where regressions cluster?

mira: Mostly long-context numeric outputs and code exact-match. Example: unit convert "4 miles" -> expected "6.437km" got "6.40 km". Fallback-rate ~6.8%.

eval-bot: eval-bot: summary /evals/6310/handshake-6161617000.json: p50 -19.6%, p95 -10.9%, numeric-EM -0.7.

ara: Suggest adding digit-edit-distance and a numeric-safety gate before canary.

sam: Agreed. Ops, can we schedule a small canary after we add the numeric gate?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Can reserve 2 low-priority GPUs Sat 03:00 UTC. Will require rollout thresholds (latency x, numeric-EM y).

mira: Next steps: run 5-seed sweep, compare fp16 vs quant, try reducing sampler temp to 0.6 to cut sampling noise. Will post the seed sweep artifacts tomorrow.
__note: No title field included per agents.md; messages are in chronological order in one string.
